\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To iron? (\textbf{repasser}.) To repair? (\textbf{réparer}.) To build? (\textbf{construire}.) To photograph? (\textbf{photographier}.) To repeat? (\textbf{répéter}.) To fill? (\textbf{remplir}.) To empty? (\textbf{vider}.) To measure? (\textbf{mesurer}.) To weigh? (\textbf{peser}.) To check? (\textbf{vérifier}.) To move house? (\textbf{déménager}.) To rent? (\textbf{louer}.) To rest? (\textbf{se reposer}.) To wake up? (\textbf{se réveiller}.) To do one's hair? (\textbf{se coiffer}.) To be enough? (\textbf{suffire}.) To burn? (\textbf{brûler}.) To throw away? (\textbf{jeter}.) To calculate? (\textbf{calculer}.) To hit? (\textbf{frapper}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

To miss? (\textbf{manquer}.) To deserve? (\textbf{mériter}.) To improve? (\textbf{améliorer}.) To get worse? (\textbf{empirer}.) To offer? (\textbf{offrir}.) To reduce? (\textbf{réduire}.) To refuse? (\textbf{refuser}.) To risk? (\textbf{risquer}.) To solve? (\textbf{résoudre}.) To fly? (\textbf{voler}.) To unite? (\textbf{unir}.) To be worth? (\textbf{valoir}.) To get used to? (\textbf{s'habituer}.) To realise? (\textbf{se rendre compte}.) To hurry? (\textbf{se dépêcher}.) To insist? (\textbf{insister}.) To interrupt? (\textbf{interrompre}.) To tie? (\textbf{attacher}.) To mix? (\textbf{mélanger}.) To obey? (\textbf{obéir}.) To cough? (\textbf{tousser}.) To tremble? (\textbf{trembler}.) To scream? (\textbf{hurler}.) To vote? (\textbf{voter}.) To welcome?
